subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should ClawHub add this public staged skill-bundle upload protocol once the size-cap, docs, changelog, and proof blockers are resolved?
rationale: The patch fixes a real publish-path gap but also creates a new public endpoint and multipart wire contract, so maintainers should explicitly accept that API shape rather than treating it as a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve staged skill uploads after fixes
options.body: Land this protocol after the staged parser enforces the total cap before storage, the docs match the actual upload method, the changelog edit is removed, and a real large-bundle publish is proven.

options.title: Keep skill publish API unchanged
options.body: Reject this public endpoint for now and require a different approach to handling large skills.

options.title: Pause for protocol design
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers decide whether staged skills should share a broader package/skill upload API shape.

recommendation.title: Approve staged skill uploads after fixes
recommendation.body: Land this protocol after the staged parser enforces the total cap before storage, the docs match the actual upload method, the changelog edit is removed, and a real large-bundle publish is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested reviewer and has recent merged history on the publish pipeline this PR extends.
